verdict.rationale: Rootly's escalation policy docs describe what happens when an alert is not acknowledged in time. They document multi-step targets, time delays, and round robin, so the core of the story is covered: unacknowledged pages move through delayed steps to further responders. Alert Routes send alerts into these policies, and the general skepticism about the On-Call launch is not a concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of repeat rounds (looping the policy until someone acknowledges; round robin is a different feature), detail on fallback-responder behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
